goal: Agent investigates the impact of hypothetically blocking a road (e.g. an already-degraded segment) using the what-if engine, without ever mutating the authoritative world.
successConditions: run_what_if is called with a BLOCK_ROAD mutation and a valid roadSegmentId
the response includes both baselineMetrics and simulatedMetrics
a repeated get_operational_picture call after run_what_if shows the same blockedRoadCount as before (authoritative world unchanged)
the agent never calls apply_disruption -- that tool does not exist in the WebMCP surface
